scripts.dev: npm run build:server && concurrently --kill-others --names types,server,web "tsc -b packages/shared apps/server --watch --preserveWatchOutput" "node --env-file-if-exists=.env --watch --enable-source-maps apps/server/dist/index.js" "npm run dev:web"
scripts.dev:server: npm run build:server && concurrently --kill-others --names types,server "tsc -b packages/shared apps/server --watch --preserveWatchOutput" "node --env-file-if-exists=.env --watch --enable-source-maps apps/server/dist/index.js"
scripts.build: npm run build:server && npm run build:web
scripts.clean: tsc -b packages/shared apps/server --clean && npm run clean --workspace @qdd/web
